tasks.label: Local: Deploy canister suite and validate
tasks.detail: Build canisters, start a clean local replica, deploy the full suite, and call the new functions to confirm they work

tasks.label: CI: Run canister test suite
tasks.detail: Install dependencies and run the full canister test suite

tasks.label: Mainnet: Execute canister calls
tasks.detail: Run ad-hoc canister calls against mainnet as the actions identity (edit execute-canister-calls.sh to change what runs)

tasks.label: Mainnet: Verify backup canister controllers
tasks.detail: Sample 3 backup pool canisters from a user_index and confirm PO is a controller on each

tasks.label: Mainnet: Monitor long-running task
tasks.detail: Poll all user_indexes round-robin until the active long-running canister operation completes (edit monitor-long-running-task.sh to change what is polled)

tasks.label: Release: platform_orchestrator only
tasks.detail: Build and submit SNS upgrade proposal for platform_orchestrator

tasks.label: Release: platform_orchestrator + user_index
tasks.detail: Build and submit SNS upgrade proposals for platform_orchestrator and user_index

tasks.label: Release: all canisters
tasks.detail: Build and submit SNS upgrade proposals for platform_orchestrator, user_index, and individual_user_template

tasks.label: IC Dashboard: Run all snapshot queries
tasks.detail: Execute all SQL queries in queries.sql against ic_canisters.db
